title: GDP (current US$)
definition: Gross domestic product at current market prices.
notes: World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: GDP growth
definition: Annual percentage growth of GDP at constant local prices.
notes: World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: GDP per capita (current US$)
definition: GDP divided by midyear population.
notes: The measure that matters for living standards. India's headline GDP rank flatters a per-capita position outside the world's top 130.
World Bank indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: GDP per capita, PPP
definition: GDP per capita converted at purchasing power parity.
notes: World Bank indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: GNI per capita, Atlas method
definition: Gross national income per capita, Atlas conversion.
notes: World Bank indicator NY.GNP.PCAP.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Inflation, consumer prices
definition: Annual percentage change in the consumer price index.
notes: World Bank indicator FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Gross capital formation
definition: Investment in fixed assets plus inventory change, as a share of GDP.
notes: The best single proxy for how much of national income is being converted into future capacity.
World Bank indicator NE.GDI.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Gross fixed capital formation
definition: Fixed asset investment as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NE.GDI.FTOT.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Central government debt
definition: Total central government debt stock as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2009, 2018, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Gross domestic savings
definition: GDP less final consumption expenditure, as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Tax revenue
definition: Compulsory transfers to central government, as a share of GDP.
notes: India's tax-to-GDP ratio is low for its income level, which constrains every spending series on this site.
World Bank indicator GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2009, 2022, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Unemployment rate
definition: Share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment (ILO estimate).
notes: World Bank indicator SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Female labour force participation
definition: Share of women aged 15+ economically active (ILO estimate).
notes: One of India's weakest indicators against every peer — and a direct constraint on growth.
World Bank indicator SL.TLF.CACT.FE.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Exports of goods and services
definition: Value of all goods and services provided to the rest of the world.
notes: World Bank indicator NE.EXP.GNFS.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Exports as share of GDP
definition: Exports of goods and services as a percentage of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Imports of goods and services
definition: Value of all goods and services received from the rest of the world.
notes: World Bank indicator NE.IMP.GNFS.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Trade openness
definition: Sum of exports and imports as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: High-technology exports
definition: Share of manufactured exports with high R&D intensity — aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, instruments.
notes: The sharpest test of whether manufacturing is moving up the value chain. Compare against Vietnam.
World Bank indicator TX.VAL.TECH.MF.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2023, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: High-technology exports (US$)
definition: Value of high-technology manufactured exports.
notes: World Bank indicator TX.VAL.TECH.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2023, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Foreign direct investment, net inflows
definition: Net inflows of investment acquiring a lasting management interest.
notes: World Bank indicator BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: FDI net inflows as share of GDP
definition: Foreign direct investment inflows relative to economy size.
notes: World Bank indicator BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Total reserves including gold
definition: Foreign exchange reserves, SDRs, IMF position and gold.
notes: World Bank indicator FI.RES.TOTL.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Personal remittances received
definition: Transfers received from nationals working abroad.
notes: India is the world's largest remittance recipient — a strength that is also a measure of how many skilled workers left.
World Bank indicator BX.TRF.PWKR.CD.DT. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2004, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Merchandise exports
definition: Value of goods exported, customs basis.
notes: World Bank indicator TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Manufacturing value added
definition: Manufacturing output net of intermediate inputs, as a share of GDP.
notes: The single most damaging number on this site: essentially flat since 2001 despite a decade of Make in India. The 25% target has never been approached.
World Bank indicator NV.IND.MANF.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Manufacturing value added (US$)
definition: Absolute manufacturing value added.
notes: World Bank indicator NV.IND.MANF.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Manufacturing value added growth
definition: Annual growth in real manufacturing value added.
notes: World Bank indicator NV.IND.MANF.KD.ZG. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Industry value added
definition: Mining, manufacturing, construction and utilities, as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NV.IND.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Agriculture value added
definition: Agriculture, forestry and fishing, as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator NV.AGR.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Services value added
definition: Services sector output as a share of GDP.
notes: India industrialised out of order — services grew before manufacturing did. This chart is that anomaly.
World Bank indicator NV.SRV.TOTL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Employment in industry
definition: Share of total employment in the industrial sector (ILO estimate).
notes: World Bank indicator SL.IND.EMPL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Employment in agriculture
definition: Share of total employment in agriculture (ILO estimate).
notes: Still over 40%. Structural transformation has stalled — the workers left agriculture for construction and services, not factories.
World Bank indicator SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Research and development expenditure
definition: Gross domestic R&D spending as a share of GDP.
notes: India spends around 0.65% of GDP on R&D against China's 2.4%. No defence-industrial ambition survives that gap indefinitely.
World Bank indicator GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2020, 2023), which are not all the same.

title: Patent applications, residents
definition: Patent applications filed by residents.
notes: World Bank indicator IP.PAT.RESD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Patent applications, non-residents
definition: Patent applications filed by non-residents.
notes: World Bank indicator IP.PAT.NRES. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Scientific and technical journal articles
definition: Number of scientific and engineering articles published.
notes: World Bank indicator IP.JRN.ARTC.SC. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Manufactured exports
definition: Manufactured goods as a share of merchandise exports.
notes: World Bank indicator TX.VAL.MANF.ZS.UN. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2023, 2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Military expenditure
definition: Military spending as a share of GDP (SIPRI via World Bank).
notes: India's military burden has fallen steadily as a share of GDP since 2001 even as absolute spending rose — the economy grew faster than the budget.
World Bank indicator MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

Compiled by SIPRI and redistributed by the World Bank. SIPRI estimates spending on a consistent cross-country definition that does not match India's own budget headings, so this will not tie to the Ministry of Defence allocation series.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2018, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Military expenditure (US$)
definition: Absolute military spending in current dollars.
notes: World Bank indicator MS.MIL.XPND.CD. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

Compiled by SIPRI and redistributed by the World Bank. SIPRI estimates spending on a consistent cross-country definition that does not match India's own budget headings, so this will not tie to the Ministry of Defence allocation series.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2018, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Military expenditure as share of government spending
definition: Military spending as a percentage of central government expenditure.
notes: World Bank indicator MS.MIL.XPND.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

Compiled by SIPRI and redistributed by the World Bank. SIPRI estimates spending on a consistent cross-country definition that does not match India's own budget headings, so this will not tie to the Ministry of Defence allocation series.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2018, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Armed forces personnel
definition: Active duty military personnel including paramilitary where training and equipment are military.
notes: World Bank indicator MS.MIL.TOTL.P1. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

Compiled by SIPRI and redistributed by the World Bank. SIPRI estimates spending on a consistent cross-country definition that does not match India's own budget headings, so this will not tie to the Ministry of Defence allocation series.

title: Armed forces personnel share of labour force
definition: Military personnel as a share of the total labour force.
notes: World Bank indicator MS.MIL.TOTL.TF.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

Compiled by SIPRI and redistributed by the World Bank. SIPRI estimates spending on a consistent cross-country definition that does not match India's own budget headings, so this will not tie to the Ministry of Defence allocation series.

title: Access to electricity
definition: Share of population with access to electricity.
notes: From roughly 60% to near-universal. On any honest reckoning this is the single largest infrastructure achievement of the period.
World Bank indicator EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Electric power consumption per capita
definition: Electricity consumed per person per year.
notes: Still roughly a third of China's. Consumption per head is the least gameable measure of industrialisation.
World Bank indicator EG.USE.ELEC.KH.PC. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2023, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Renewable energy consumption
definition: Renewable energy as a share of total final energy consumption.
notes: Falling in this series is not necessarily bad — it partly reflects households switching off traditional biomass.
World Bank indicator EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Renewable electricity output
definition: Electricity generated from renewable sources as a share of total generation.
notes: World Bank indicator EG.ELC.RNEW.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Energy imports, net
definition: Net energy imports as a share of energy use.
notes: Import dependence is the strategic vulnerability that most constrains Indian foreign policy.
World Bank indicator EG.IMP.CONS.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2022, 2023), which are not all the same.

title: CO2 emissions per capita
definition: Carbon dioxide emissions per person.
notes: India's per-capita emissions remain far below the world average — the core of its position in climate negotiations.
World Bank indicator EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Mobile cellular subscriptions
definition: Mobile subscriptions per 100 people.
notes: World Bank indicator IT.CEL.SETS.P2. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Individuals using the internet
definition: Share of population using the internet.
notes: World Bank indicator IT.NET.USER.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Fixed broadband subscriptions
definition: Fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people.
notes: India's weakest connectivity metric. Mobile-first adoption left fixed-line infrastructure far behind every peer.
World Bank indicator IT.NET.BBND.P2. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Air transport, passengers carried
definition: Passengers carried by air carriers registered in the country.
notes: World Bank indicator IS.AIR.PSGR. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Air transport freight
definition: Volume of freight carried by air.
notes: World Bank indicator IS.AIR.GOOD.MT.K1. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Container port traffic
definition: Container throughput measured in twenty-foot equivalent units.
notes: World Bank indicator IS.SHP.GOOD.TU. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Urban population
definition: Share of population living in urban areas.
notes: India urbanised far more slowly than every comparator. Under-urbanisation, not over-urbanisation, is the planning problem.
World Bank indicator SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Population living in slums
definition: Share of the urban population living in slum households.
notes: World Bank indicator EN.POP.SLUM.UR.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2019, 2022), which are not all the same.

title: Life expectancy at birth
definition: Years a newborn would live under prevailing mortality patterns.
notes: World Bank indicator SP.DYN.LE00.IN. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Infant mortality rate
definition: Deaths of infants under one year per 1,000 live births.
notes: Roughly a two-thirds reduction since 2001 — among the strongest social gains in the dataset.
World Bank indicator SP.DYN.IMRT.IN. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Maternal mortality ratio
definition: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births.
notes: World Bank indicator SH.STA.MMRT. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Under-five mortality rate
definition: Deaths before age five per 1,000 live births.
notes: World Bank indicator SH.DYN.MORT. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Access to basic sanitation
definition: Share of population using at least basic sanitation services.
notes: The steepest improvement of any social indicator here, concentrated in 2014-2019.
World Bank indicator SH.STA.BASS.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Current health expenditure
definition: Total health spending, public and private, as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Out-of-pocket health expenditure
definition: Share of health spending paid directly by households.
notes: Among the highest in the world. Medical costs remain a leading cause of household impoverishment in India.
World Bank indicator SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Government expenditure on education
definition: Public education spending as a share of GDP.
notes: World Bank indicator SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2021, 2022, 2023), which are not all the same.

title: Adult literacy rate
definition: Share of people aged 15+ who can read and write.
notes: World Bank indicator SE.ADT.LITR.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2020, 2022, 2024), which are not all the same.

title: Secondary school enrolment, gross
definition: Total secondary enrolment as a share of the official school-age population.
notes: World Bank indicator SE.SEC.ENRR. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2012, 2022, 2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Tertiary school enrolment, gross
definition: Total tertiary enrolment as a share of the relevant age cohort.
notes: World Bank indicator SE.TER.ENRR. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Poverty headcount at $2.15/day
definition: Share of population below the international extreme poverty line, 2017 PPP.
notes: The most consequential number in this dataset. Hundreds of millions moved above the line in this period.
World Bank indicator SI.POV.DDAY. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2022, 2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Gini index
definition: Income distribution inequality, 0 = perfect equality.
notes: World Bank indicator SI.POV.GINI. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
Peer comparison uses each country's latest available year (2022, 2024, 2025), which are not all the same.

title: Population, total
definition: Total midyear resident population.
notes: World Bank indicator SP.POP.TOTL. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Fertility rate, total
definition: Births per woman over a lifetime at current age-specific rates.
notes: India fell below the 2.1 replacement rate around 2020. The demographic dividend has a closing window.
World Bank indicator SP.DYN.TFRT.IN. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Population aged 65 and above
definition: Share of population aged 65+.
notes: World Bank indicator SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.

title: Population aged 0-14
definition: Share of population aged 0-14.
notes: World Bank indicator SP.POP.0014.TO.ZS. History is restated by the World Bank as national accounts are revised; this series is rewritten in full on every pipeline run rather than appended to.
